notes.title: EVER FORWARD COMES TO CONSOLES TODAY
notes.content:
[h1]Hey all players,[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36934920/871f5fc62ce9be5c0f353b3385f96a1bb3fcf152.jpg[/img]

We’ve partnered with PM Studio to port our 3D adventure puzzle game, Ever Forward, to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S, available now as both a digital download and a physical release!

Ever Forward tells the story of a girl, Maya, who is lost in a strange world somewhere between reality and imagination. She is alone to confront her internal despair on her journey of discovery, where she must unlock her memories and face her fears to unravel the secrets of the world. 

You must be sharp and use your observational skills to solve multiple puzzles to discover the mystery of Maya's past and what dark secrets she has buried. You will be able to complete puzzles in a variety of different ways, thanks to mechanics such as teleportation, gravity manipulation, and more. Only you can help Maya explore the idyllic, pastel-colored fields, charming seaside coasts, and futuristic neon environments where stealth and careful observation are key.

notes.title: PATHEA GAMES KICKS OFF THE SBT PRESEASON TODAY
notes.content:
GET SBT PRE-SEASON [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341230]HERE[/url]!

Welcome back to the future where speed, strategy and intensity are sweeping across the world with fast-growing Sport; Super Buckyball Tournament. Everyone can join, no matter if you are human, android, robot or have had your DNA spliced with an animal. But beware that only the toughest have what it takes to make it to the top.

[previewyoutube=sRIqvwsgOJY;full][/previewyoutube]
[u][b]Features[/b][/u]

In addition to our six characters, two stadiums and mission system featured during the game’s open alpha earlier this year, the preseason will include:

•	New challenger Samba: This guy is the first Chimera on the field and being half tiger, he is someone to watch out for. He is now one of the strongest characters in the game and his ultimate which gives him a massive speed boost, makes him hard to catch up with.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359871/064254f7431459c0648cb3060e85b5c43aa235c5.gif[/img]

•	2 Arcade modes: Dodgeball & Mayhem
These to modes will be unlocked when you reach lvl 6 and will rotate every 24 hours, meaning one mode will be available to enjoy every day.

•	Dodgeball challenges you to avoid getting hit by two balls while making sure those balls don’t rest on your side of the field for more than 12 seconds. 

•	Mayhem is a super-powered version of Standard mode, as abilities charge three times faster and players take control of random characters each time a goal is scored. 


[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359871/2215cc640fe0254bd1d5de3e2a623d09cba32b47.jpg[/img]

•	New lobby with cool new UI and animated backgrounds. 

•	In-game background music has finally been added and with new sound effects for all characters, the game should definitely be experienced with the volume turned up.

•	a comprehensive collection of skins (which includes accessories and player icons), 

•	Season pass with 60 levels. You will now be able to level up this all new season pass by completing daily and weekly challenges and earn special rewards.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359871/558a8c93dae66a7c81e49172826f2b114fe2f35e.gif[/img]

•	High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP).
We have given the whole game a makeover and optimized it to HDRP which has improved graphics and performance and gives you a much smoother gaming experience.

Our player-friendly community where you can find new friends to play with, join special activities or challenge other players is on the official SBT [url=https://discord.gg/BAc8gvw]Discord[/url]

To keep up to date with all the latest information on Super Buckyball Tournament, pleas follow us on:

[url=https://twitter.com/SuperBuckyBall]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/SuperBuckyballTournament]Facebook[/url]
[url=http://www.instagram.com/superbuckyballtournament/]Instagram[/url]

If you like us want to see the game grow and succeed, a nice review would be a great help.
We would also be super stoked if you were to wishlist the full game Here.

Thanks for your support!!!

notes.title: My Time at Sandrock Announced Today!
notes.content:
ATTENTION: PATHEA GAMES NEEDS YOUR HELP!! PLEASE SUPPORT OUR[h1] [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1757963851/my-time-at-sandrock-us?ref=7542hn&token=dfc546fd ]KICKSTARTER.[/url][/h1]

[h2]Hey Sandrockers![/h2]

[b]My Time at Sandrock[/b] – Just like My Time at Portia, the game takes place in perhaps the only wholesome post-apocalyptic world in the gaming industry right now; a world where humans have successfully restarted civilization after, long ago, nearly destroying themselves through greed, unbridled technology, and warfare in a period they refer to as the “The Age of Darkness.” Current citizens of this world now band together and reject the Old World ideologies as they work to rebuild, but remaking an entire civilization isn’t easy…

[previewyoutube=aolJ3ZHzhCo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]First day on the job…[/b]
Taking a job offer in the frontier town of Sandrock, you’ll assume the role of a fledgling builder being sent to a wild and rugged townscape on the brink of collapse. It’s up to you and your trusty toolset to gather resources, build machines, fix up your workshop into a well-oiled production machine, and save the town from the jaws of economic ruin, as well as a few other unexpected complications...

[b]No job too big, no task too small![/b]
Customize and build your workshop with an intricate set of machines that all work together to produce parts of huge structures for the town that you assemble piece by piece; or head to your worktable to craft hundreds of unique items that can help out individual townspeople or be placed throughout your own workshop: watch Sandrock transform before your eyes as every contribution you make to town appears permanently in the world!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997750/407e2594aab1688c8ed88127260acc1d2d3b521d.jpg[/img]

[b]There and back again [/b]
Explore the vast deserts surrounding Sandrock: dive into ruins to find ancient relics from the Old World, face the dangers of dungeons and their denizens, then return to your homestead with encumbering bags of treasure in tow. Take your profits and convert the empty prairie lands around you into farmable land for a more leisurely lifestyle, then sell your crops, or transform them into delicious dishes to share with all your new friends in town!
 
[b]It takes a wild bunch…[/b]
The people of Sandrock are hardy and tenacious, and one can hardly survive in such an arduous climate without developing a sense of humor. Befriend the local sheriff to hear about his tall tales, help out the chatty ranch family and they’ll help you in turn, spend some time with a local artist and hear about her hopes and aspirations. Meeting and helping these characters leads to not only making new friends, but also people to support you in building your workshop! And who knows, even romance might be in the air…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997750/a77e183ee5fd00442fa08a7f4a2b6f562299ea5d.jpg[/img]
 
My Time at Sandrock brings a plethora of new features to the table:
[list]
[*] [b]New Combat[/b] - a revamped combat system that allows the player to quickly shift between melee combat and 3rd person shooting mechanics.
[*] [b]Great Music [/b]- an original soundtrack with dynamic in-game music that reflects where the player is and what they're doing
[*] [b]More Elaborate Story and Deeper Characters[/b]- a vastly enriched storyline, hundreds of side-quests boasting over 30 completely new characters, each getting more attention than before with their own story to discover, as well as the return of a few familiar faces for fans of the series.
[*] [b]Build with Friends! Co-op multiplayer[/b] - Perhaps the most exciting addition to the game is a new multiplayer function that will finally allow players to visit a unique multiplayer map where they can build a workshop together and experience an additional storyline that unfolds there…
[/list]

Fans of the series will find everything they enjoyed about Portia and more, and new players will feel right at home in the delightful life-sim RPG that is My Time at Sandrock. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1084600/My_Time_at_Sandrock/
[h2][b]See you there and Rock on Sandrockers![/b][/h2]

[h2]Available Now!![/h2] After 4 long years of development, Ever Forward is finally here! Join us as we take you through Maya’s arduous journey: dashing, sneaking, and sometimes falling (with style)  towards her goal: to unlock the fragmented memories hidden away deep in her mind. The full version of Ever Forward will allow players to see Maya through to her destination as well as experience the game’s most intricate and ingeniously designed puzzles: stretch your brain to its limits as you apply stealth, creativity, logic, and even gravity bending methods to arrive at each puzzle’s unique solution, each one more devious than the last!

Those who support us within a week of launch [b](before August 20th)[/b] will receive the [b]OST[/b] and the first set of [b]DLC puzzles for free, so do act now![/b]

We’re so excited to finally be able to launch Ever Forward; it’s been a heck of a ride up to this point, and we can’t wait to see where things go from here and what’s coming up on the horizon. Finally: a very special shout out and thank you to all the folks who have supported us since the early days! Your support has kept us going and we wouldn’t have reached this point without you.

[h3]And with that, we invite everyone to… enjoy Ever Forward!
[/h3]

notes.title: Ever Forward Release date CONFIRMED!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey gang! [/h1]Its official and we finally have a release date set! I feel like this is my wedding date lol. She said yes! Haha no, I’m joking…. [u][b]August 13th[/b][/u], Ever Forward will be released!!! The game starts at $14.99 and during the first week there will be a [b][u]10% discount.[/u][/b] 

[h3]We are full of gratitude, appreciation, and respect for the players that have supported us through this journey.[/h3]
We have taken the awesome feedback you guys gave for the demo prologue and tried to include all that in the final build. You all wanted a better tutorial, more puzzles and more interaction. We have done all that and more: there are many new puzzles that will absolutely blow your mind and challenge you until you’re blue in the face and ready to throw your controller... out of pure joy! We’ve also added a few challenge puzzles for galaxy brain IQ 200 players who think they can handle it. Spoiler: you can’t handle it. Better optimization, music and general polish will help the gaming experience be smoother and hopefully just a more enjoyable experience. 

[h3]For all you Maya fans-[/h3]New animation and actions for Maya will help you to solve puzzles faster. And of course, the full version of the game will bring you the thrilling conclusion to Maya’s narrative; you can finally know exactly what happened to her and why her world even exists… 

[h3]I must leave you with this…[/h3]  [i](Going back to work) [/i]
We want to make the best games we can make, for the people who will enjoy it. We whole heartily believe that games, especially in this day and age are essential to life and happiness for many people. When we’re in over our heads in life, games can be the winds in our sails to get back to safe waters. Often when dealing with adverse times, games are the best way to release the tension and pressures of life. For many of us, games are the light at the end of, sometimes, the dark tunnels life puts you in. It’s our duty and our joy to make dope games that are more than just entertainment. We take great honor and pride in the role we play as game developers. We want our games to excite people and be used as a platform for spreading love and happiness. Thus far this experience of connecting with gamers and hearing / seeing what people share and how they solve our puzzles has been the best part for us. None of us expected this community to be so impactful and supportive of our project, we are truly humbled. [h2]The Devs….[/h2]

notes.content:
[h3][b]It was[/b] [/h3]
then we were finally ready to start bridging the gap between the environment for our world and the environment for our puzzles.

Why not build the environment first, and the puzzles second? And build a world where we can use the mechanics we’ve already established for puzzles?

This was the next stage of concept design for our maps, referred to amongst the team as, “铁憨憨,”(Tie Hanhan)  or something like "blockhead".

notes.title: Early Design of Ever Forward Part 6
notes.content:
[h3]Then we thought [/h3] 
of another classic, Shadow of the Colossus. Maybe we could make this thing into a boss rush! That’d keep things exciting, eh?

This didn’t really get anywhere, though, sadly. With our core design, the block/stealth/motion puzzles already in place, we found it impossible to tie everything together. Having a game consist of block puzzles followed by boss fights once again felt way too dissonant. 

Furthermore, coming up with a bunch of interesting boss fights would prolong development time indefinitely, and early attempts just didn’t feel good enough for us to want to go in this direction.

notes.title: Early Design of Ever Forward Part 5
notes.content:
[h3]Then there was our protagonist[/h3] 
to think about. Being a 12-year-old girl, she’s not capable of much in the way of acrobatics. No tomb raiding or assassin creeding for our little puzzle solver! 

This, however, led us to worry that playing as our character wouldn’t be exciting or stimulating enough.
We tried adding a few things to make our protagonist’s physical gameplay a bit more high-octane: we gave her some high-winding vines to climb; 

unfortunately, as we tried to affect the intangible pacing of the game, we found it impossible not to disrupt the actual speed of gameplay; 

in order for our hero to feel right, we couldn’t let her climb up the vines too quickly, it felt too dissonant packaged with everything else we’d made so far.

notes.title: Early Design of Ever Forward Part 4
notes.content:
[h3]The idea [/h3]here was to create a duality of freedom/confinement as players solved puzzles & made their way through the game. 

Ultimately, this over-world idea was scrapped, yet the aesthetic ended up being something we’d hold onto all the way into the final stages of dev.
The problems with this over-world were numerous: the open space was too nice and made players hate the puzzles. Our script was linear, which made the whole “open-world” aspect meaningless. There was nothing to do in the over-world except awkwardly move between the puzzles.

And finally, a somewhat minor issue, some of our puzzles taking place in strange spaces didn’t really make sense on the map.

notes.title: Early Design of Ever Forward Part 3
notes.content:
[h2]In the beginning,[/h2] it was hard to see the forest for the trees.
Our first versions of Protoform were… alright. But we felt like we were making a silent film in the era of modern blockbusters. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36934920/e611367cd384d8a46907d08ef1635ce19313792c.jpg[/img]
We committed some of the very sins we noted & promised to avoid at the beginning of the development process: our puzzle gameplay felt completely disconnected from the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36934920/aff29b2b6902254c488f56989683e63d8c0ee5e8.jpg[/img]
Looking all of our puzzles in a Portal-like lab interior was confining and boring. Overcoming technical problems, design issues, graphical issues, we now think of Protoform, and the metal laboratory in which it was set, as the cocoon from which Ever forward emerged.

Our first attempt at breaking out of the cocoon was with an over-world like what you see here:
A clean and tidy island with soft white sand, and black buildings holding unsolved puzzles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36934920/5452a80e3dbd36ac2a8e8a1ef1ebc3b13abf9ae0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ever Forward Update 2!
Dev Log
notes.content:
[h1]Early Design of Ever Forward Part 2[/h1]
[h2]Dev Log June 12th [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897371/045687dda70f1225320b1df44371107c963b813a.png[/img]


We, like pretty much every other puzzle dev team were inspired in no small part by the 2007 hit, Portal. The one issue with that being… Portal came out in 2007. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897371/96414323d31c9c40d05053db9f5aa484427655c1.jpg[/img]


Though we didn’t feel the need to greatly innovate graphically for the puzzle genre, since Portal, there have been plenty of other breakthrough games in design: Journey, The Witness, What Remains of Edith Finch, just to name a few. These games, among others, represent a vast evolution of game design philosophy, and we didn’t want to be left out.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897371/68e562f3fb0ae154792e20d86b003ed40e95196c.jpg[/img]


A few things we took away from the success of all these games were: a good single-player game has its story woven directly into the gameplay, separating the two was unacceptable, and a simple, linear experience with no world-building wouldn’t be tolerated either. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36934920/abe1bd510d9f8d96e3fe15e089f1e31e57a049a9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897371/67f754d501f0a1d756ab9de7d15a3dfccc9447f6.jpg[/img]
[h1]Early Design of Ever Forward Part 1[/h1]
[h2]Dev Log June 5th[/h2]
Protoform was the original title of our game; we started with the goal of creating a pure puzzle game, and from the get go, we worked extremely hard to make our puzzles feel good.
Our first major milestone was reaching a point where we liked our puzzles, felt like they were not just unique among puzzle games, but also unique from puzzle to puzzle within the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897371/8e5bd1ce026ede13ec4e4e05830b5947b6dcc32d.png[/img]
Four years later, we’re close to releasing our finished title, aptly named Everforward, representing the journey of our character moving forward through her simulated world, and the journey of us moving forward as a development team.Developing the puzzles was the first step, but it became clear to us that we needed more than just pure puzzles to make the game really stand out. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897371/1a3e4181061bf38fe1157b942a4643a7214e76cf.png[/img]
WE started writing the script then, it was all very basic at that time, but the idea of a mother and daughter, themes of controlling and being controlled, these were all there from the beginning.

notes.title: Ever Forward Demo Updated
3D VISIONARY PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME “EVER FORWARD”DEMO OUT NOW
notes.content:
We are happy to announced that our imaginative puzzle platform adventure title Ever Forward as a free demo, and it is scheduled for launch this summer on PC.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36934920/9843706c5fe716ffaefb58fb655176837321edf7.jpg[/img]

In Ever Forward players impersonate Maya; a twelve-year-old girl lost on the edge of dreams and reality. 
As you unveil the mysteries of her subconscious, you will unlock her memories step-by-step and progressively face her fears and sorrows. 
By facing challenging puzzles and exploring breathtaking environments, you will slowly reveal the secrets buried in Maya’s heart.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36934920/347856a8f7cd62df7bab6624705b54d9d074dc0c.jpg[/img]

The Ever Forward demo will let fans experience nearly 40% of the entire game content, challenging them with eight intricately designed puzzles. At the same time, players will be able to immerse themselves with the game’s dual environments and dive into the main characters (Maya) memories and secrets. 

Note that the saving file will be inherited in the full release version

If you like Ever Forward Demo and find this game fun, please add to your wish list, so to receive the latest game information.

Thanks for the support, at the same time we would much appreciate if you can share it with friends and fellow gamers.
